lines: Don't be so kind to me
What face am I supposed to make?
All these words piled up, I can't see
Your face in profile
Where was it again?
The key I lost is still nowhere to be found
A sigh
Passing each other by, being stubborn, it wears me out
Just a little farther off
My hand can't reach
Do I really want to hold on tight?
To that shadow of yours
Don't be so kind to me
See, we're hurting each other again
With all the lies piled up, I'm
Unable to move anymore
Don't stare at me with those eyes
What face am I supposed to make?
I'm always hesitating, but someday
Will I be able to laugh about it?
How many
days have I spent with you, I wonder
And still
the words we've exchanged are far too few
Just a little closer
The distance between you and me
I can't quite get a grip on it
We're so close now!
Don't be so kind to me
See, we're hurting each other again
Under all the lies piled up, I can't hear
Your words
Hiding my true voice
I hum this melody
To my heart, slowly changing, I
give myself over
I don't even understand myself
Though part of me wants to know you
Holding back these clashing feelings a little
I'll grope for the wall I can't see
Don't be so kind to me
See, we're hurting each other again
All these lies piled up
They only hurt now, you know?
I want to go see you right away, but
I can't find the words
At least for the last page, I want to show you
A smile!
